title: Quenched Peppery Peruvian Fish Ceviche
description: A bright, peppery ceviche with a velvety citrus base and a touch of honey, finished with a quick broil for a subtle char.
instructions: Cut the sea bass fillets into 1/2 inch cubes and place them in a glass bowl.
Pour the fresh lime juice over the fish, ensuring all cubes are coated, and stir gently.
Add the honey, black pepper, sea salt, minced garlic, and finely chopped red onion to the bowl and mix well.
Sprinkle the chopped cilantro and sliced chili over the mixture, then stir again.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 15 minutes to allow the fish to "cook" in the citrus.
While the fish marinates, preheat the oven broiler on high and line a baking sheet with foil.
Once chilled, spread the marinated fish evenly on the baking sheet and broil for 2 minutes until the edges are slightly caramelized.
Remove the sheet from the oven, let it cool for a minute, then transfer the ceviche to a serving dish.
Garnish with a drizzle of honey and a sprinkle of fresh cilantro before serving immediately.
